rot.fixedTarget.curiosidades.grigoriev: This position is a study by Nikolai Grigoriev, from 1920. Grigoriev, a Russian chess player born in Moscow, was one of the great composers of pawn endgame studies.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.e1: Defence: to fix a pawn is to stop it with your own, head-on, so that it cannot advance.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.e2: A fixed pawn loses its reserve tempi and stands still, waiting to be attacked.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.e3: The black king is close to the h3-pawn, and yours is far from both pawns.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.e4: Look at the a-file: there is one empty square between the pawns, a4. Whoever takes it first fixes the other pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.err.d7e8.1: With that move, the a5-pawn gets a resource: it can advance.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.err.d7e8.2: The black pawn goes to a4 and fixes yours on a3: on the a-file, the last move was Black’s.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.err.d7c7.2: The black king will capture on h3. Your king takes a5, but the h-pawn promotes first.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.err.h3h4.1: With that move, the h4-pawn comes within reach of the black king.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.err.h3h4.2: The black king goes to g4 and captures the h4-pawn on the next move.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.certo: Exactly! Your pawn fixes the black pawn on a5. Now it has no reserve tempi left.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.revela: The best is to advance the pawn to a4 and fix the black pawn on a5.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Keep playing with White and see how Black attacks.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.fins.coroa: The black pawn has promoted. In defence, fix the enemy pawn and only then run with the king.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.fins.capturado: A pawn has fallen. In defence, fix the enemy pawn and follow the black king, move by move.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.fins.afogado: The black king is stalemated: stalemate is a draw, and the defence reached its goal.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.fins.repeticao: The position repeated: a draw, and the defence reached its goal.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.fins.limite: Black made no progress: the draw was held.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l1: The a5-pawn is fixed: Black no longer has a pawn move on the a-file.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l2: The black king goes after the h3-pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l3: Your king runs to the kingside, heading for f5.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l4: The black king captures on h3.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l5: Your king reaches f5, close to the h6-pawn and the black king.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex1.l6: The black pawn advances. The second part of the defence begins: the king follows the black king.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.e1: Defence: to synchronise is to move your king in step with the enemy king, move by move.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.e2: Here the rhythm is the lateral opposition: the kings on the same rank, with one square between them.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.e3: The h5-pawn will come down, and the black king will escort it. Yours must come down too.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5g6.1: With that move, your king goes up while the black pawn comes down.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5g6.2: The black pawn goes to h4, and your king arrives too late to stop it.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5f6.1: With that move, your king goes up while the black pawn comes down.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5e6.2: The black pawn goes to h4, and your king arrives too late to stop it.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5g5.1: With that move, your king attacks h5, but the black pawn can advance.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5g5.2: The black pawn goes to h4. Your king is behind the pawn and can no longer get in front of it.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5e5.1: With that move, your king moves away from the squares in front of the pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5e5.2: The black king goes to g2, beside the pawn's path, and escorts its advance to h1.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5e4.1: With that move, your king moves away from the squares in front of the pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.err.f5e4.2: The black king goes to g2, beside the pawn's path, and escorts its advance to h1.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.certo: Exactly! Your king comes down to f4 and is ready to follow the black king.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.revela: The best is to bring the king down to f4 and follow the black king, rank by rank.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Keep playing with White and see how Black attacks.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.fins.coroa: The black pawn has promoted. In defence, follow the black king, move by move, until your king reaches the front of the pawn.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.fins.limite: Black made no progress: the draw was held.

rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l0: Now watch the rhythm: when the black king comes down, yours comes down too, on the same rank.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l1: The black pawn advances to h4.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l2: Your king goes to f3: same rank as the black king, with g3 between them.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l3: The black king comes down to h2.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l4: And yours comes down to f2, in step, with g2 between the kings.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l5: The black pawn advances to h3.
rot.fixedTarget.ideia.ex2.l6: Your king goes to f1 and guards g1 and g2. The h-pawn cannot get through.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.1: Defence: back to the study. See what happens when White does not fix the a5-pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.2: Your king runs straight to attack the a5-pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.3: The black king goes after the h3-pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.5: Now the a-pawn arrives late: the black king has already captured h3, and the h5 pawn is free. Black moves first, promotes first and wins.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.6: Now the king heads for the centre, but the pawn stays on a3.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.8: The black pawn goes to a4 and fixes yours on a3: on the a-file, the last move was Black’s.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.9: The black king captures the h3-pawn, while your king comes back to e3.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.10: Your king tries to come closer. The black king protects the h5-pawn and steps out of its way, to g5.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.11: Black uses the reserve tempo: the pawn goes to h4. Your king goes to f3, and the black king takes the opposition on f5: your king has to give way.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.semFixar.12: With the pawn on a4, the last move on the a-file would be White’s. Fixing comes before running, in defence and in attack too.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.1: Defence: see how keeping in step with the black king holds the draw to the end.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.2: Both kings come down together, rank by rank, until yours reaches f1.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.3: If the black king goes to the corner...
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.4: Your king returns to f2 and covers g1 and g2.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.5: The black pawn advances to h2 and takes away its own king’s last square.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.6: Your king goes to f1, and the black king has no moves: stalemate, a draw.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.7: And what if the black king leaves the corner to go after the a4-pawn?
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.8: Your king steps into h2 and captures the h3-pawn.
rot.fixedTarget.demos.compasso.9: Both kings race to the a-file. Yours reaches c1 in time and guards b1 and b2: the a-pawn does not get through, and it is a draw.
